scope: Garage News implementation only; concurrent community, economy, editor, audio and deployment work retained.
implemented: 100/1000/10000 distinct physical-track racers, deduplicated across cars/revisions
Verified track/lap world records; ties and slower times silent
Observed daily friend overtakes and percentile drops on public comparable boards
Native Garage News/Friends with retained live showroom and scoped caches

load_bounds.demand: POST on explicit News entry; one pass per UTC day, ten-minute runnable window; no automatic next-day or inactive-player jobs
load_bounds.percentile_cache: Rebuild at most once per demanded board per UTC day; unchanged revisions reused across days; only presentation-cache row locks
load_bounds.unchanged: History query joins small revision/roster metadata; skips watch JSON, PB peer reads and rank aggregation
load_bounds.idle: One indexed active-demand candidate query, with no raced-board reads when no demand exists
load_bounds.feed: Pure keyset read, 30 items + one lookahead; no COUNT; only needed labels/tick-rate returned
load_bounds.client: At most 100 rows; account/origin-scoped 60-second reads; at most four visible follow-up reads; no hidden/prepared/outgoing refresh
load_bounds.retention: 90-day read floor; at most 100 expired rows pruned per minute via expiry index, up to 100 excess inbox rows per active pass; chunked erasure
load_bounds.race_capture: No friend/racer fanout; indexed result capture and constant-size owner news. Lifetime participation has one-time SQL seeding. No new worker process.

semantics: First daily check/new friendship establishes a baseline; no historical defeat spam.
Daily comparisons show observed state; transient crossings that reverse between checks can be missed.
Track revision/car/rules stay pinned; deleted-account public times remain comparable.
Blocking removes the friendship, suppresses actor/creator news and clears matching native cache rows without background reads.
